scope: Six ready endpoint anonymized PCAP derivatives of accepted native dnscat2 lab traffic

captures.provenance: Endpoint anonymized derivative of native encrypted lab traffic
captures.transform: Role preserving RFC 5737 IPv4, RFC 3849 IPv6 and locally administered MAC endpoint replacement; matching ARP and IPv6 control address fields updated; IPv4 and transport checksums recomputed; timestamps, frame order, frame lengths and complete DNS payload bytes unchanged. Protocol multicast and unspecified addresses retained except address derived solicited node membership groups mapped consistently.
